Inscrutable progenitors. Grey- skinned, tall humanoids garbed in black plate. Uplift and devolve creatures on bizarre, enigmatic whims.

AC 15 (plate), HP 49, ATK 3 primal chisel +6 (3d6) or devolve or uplift, MV near (fly), S +5, D +3, C +4, I +4, W +4, Ch +4, AL N, LV 10

Devolve. Touch one mortal creature, which loses 1d4 INT permanently. Degenerates into slime at 0 INT.

Uplift. Touch one mortal creature that loses 1d4 CON permanently and gains one anatomical feature, such as gills or claws. Alternately, grant sentience to one mortal creature with INT 5 (-3) or lower.
